home.title: Bách Mã Viên - Cowboy-style Horse Riding in Đà Nẵng
home.description: Bách Mã Viên is a Wild West-style horse riding ranch in Hòa Bắc, Đà Nẵng. 3 ticket packages from 199,000 VND, a saloon café and a Cowboy Town photo zone.

about.title: About Bách Mã Viên and the team
about.description: Who is Bách Mã Viên: a cowboy-style riding ranch in Hòa Bắc, Đà Nẵng, with Vietnamese horses, and the team behind the project.

services.title: Ticket prices and services
services.description: 3 tickets at Bách Mã Viên: Visit the Farm 199,000 VND, Cowboy Package 399,000 VND, Real Cowboy Package 539,000 VND. Open 08:00 – 19:00, closed Mondays.

menu.title: Bách Mã Café Menu and Western Refreshments
menu.description: The Ranch Bar menu: Bách Mã coconut coffee, Cowboy coffee, tea, Wild West Fizz sodas, fresh juices and classics, from 10,000 VND, served at the ranch in Hòa Bắc, Đà Nẵng.

booking.title: Book tickets
booking.description: Book Bách Mã Viên tickets: choose your date and ticket quantities and we'll contact you to confirm.

experience.title: 3D experience: tour Bách Mã Viên through scenes and video
experience.description: Walk around Bách Mã Viên before you arrive: 12 stops and 16 zoomable, draggable 3D views, plus a 2 minute 19 second demo video through Cowboy Town, the café, the stables and the riding ring.

horses.title: Meet the horses of Bách Mã Viên
horses.description: Meet the 10 Vietnamese horses of Bách Mã Viên: Bông, Bơ, Bách, Bin, Bo, Bi, Bắp, Bí, Bún and Bao. Their temperaments, roles and which horse suits you.
